turns.peer:
As peer: assay this.

---
Colleagues, I want to begin by thanking everyone who has contributed to the Learning Commons this year. The energy in that space has been remarkable, and visitors from the state office commented on it during their October walkthrough. Our peer tutors logged more than four thousand contact hours, a number that speaks for itself. Faculty referrals were up in every division, and the writing consultants in particular have built something durable. I have been proud to represent this work at the regional consortium. As many of you know, the Perkins supplement that has underwritten a portion of our staffing was always structured as a three-year award. We have known for some time that the funding landscape would eventually shift. The college remains deeply committed to student support, and that commitment is not in question. While we finalize the spring schedule, and with gratitude for everyone's flexibility, evening and weekend hours at the Learning Commons will end after December 19, and the four part-time evening consultant positions will not be renewed. Daytime operations continue unchanged. I know this news lands in a busy season. Thank you, sincerely, for everything you have built here.
---
turns.reply:
```
Residue:
# Learning Commons evening and weekend hours end after December 19

- Cause: Perkins supplement was a three-year award; funding period ends.
- Affected: four part-time evening consultant positions — not renewed.
- Unaffected: daytime operations continue unchanged.
- Thank you for the work you have done here.

Evaporated: nine sentences of praise, metrics, and reassurance; function — cushioning a staffing cut and a service reduction.
Operative sentence: 11 of 12, coordinate clause chained after "while we finalize the spring schedule, and with gratitude for everyone's flexibility."
Finding: above the floor once compressed · erosion direction smooth · operative sentence buried in a subordinate/coordinate chain with two softeners in the same sentence · no rough edge — manufacturing signature flagged.

This is a finding, not a draft.
```

Note: the load-bearing thank-you (one sentence) survives the compression. The other nine did not carry information — they carried tone. The tell is structural, not tonal: the sentence that ends four jobs and cuts public hours is not its own sentence. It rides in on a scheduling clause and a gratitude clause, both grammatically superior to it. Nobody wrote an objectionable sentence about a real cut. That absence is the finding.
